verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a set of plain markdown skill folders that you install and run locally. A recorded hands-on probe copied a skill into a local project directory and read it back cleanly. Hermes can install it straight from a git clone, and a porting guide covers adding new harnesses, so no vendor-hosted service is required for the product itself. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting statement in the evidence, and documentation of fully offline/local-model operation (the evals and harness lists centre on third-party agents like Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI).
